name: recipes
description: Recipe, pantry and meal planning for a household

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend:https: npm exec -w packages/frontend -- ng serve --configuration development,https
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm test -w packages/shared-types && npm test -w packages/backend
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm exec -w packages/backend -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.seed: npm run build -w packages/shared-types && npm run seed -w packages/backend
